# Beats and Backlog

> A writing-first publication about video games, anime, and music — comfort, nostalgia, and limited hours, in a Samurai Champloo woodblock-and-vinyl aesthetic.

## Project Overview

**Tech Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind v4, MDX (@next/mdx). Static-first (SSG), no database.
**Status:** Active development, pre-launch (no git commits yet).
**Purpose:** An indie publication that pays respect to the culture and holds the door for who's coming up. Voice is the moat.

## Key Files by Area

### Content & Data
- `src/lib/posts.ts` — MDX discovery, frontmatter, reading-time, content types
- `src/lib/columns.ts` — the 8-column registry
- `src/lib/columnThemes.ts` — per-column identity (mood, accent, monogram, voice)
- `content/posts/*.mdx` — the posts

### Routes
- `src/app/page.tsx` — home (Hero + Now Spinning + Latest + Columns)
- `src/app/posts/[slug]/page.tsx` — article page
- `src/app/columns/[column]/page.tsx` — column dispatcher (bespoke vs themed)
- `src/app/tribute/page.tsx`, `src/app/about/page.tsx`

### Columns & Components
- `src/components/ColumnLayout.tsx`, `ColumnSeal.tsx` — themed shell + stamp
- `src/components/NightcapColumn.tsx`, `ComfortModeColumn.tsx`, `BacklogColumn.tsx` — bespoke worlds
- `src/components/Hero.tsx`, `Verdict.tsx`, `ThePour.tsx`, `PostCard.tsx`, `Divider.tsx`

### Integrations & Config
- `src/lib/igdb.ts` — IGDB game covers (Twitch OAuth, fail-soft)
- `next.config.ts` — MDX + remark plugins + IGDB image host
- `src/app/globals.css` — design tokens + pattern/motion classes
- `mdx-components.tsx` — MDX → component map

## Common Tasks

**Add a post:** create `content/posts/<slug>.mdx` with frontmatter (title, date, column, excerpt, optional verdict/pour/nightcap).
**Add/edit a column's look:** edit `src/lib/columnThemes.ts`; for a bespoke world, add a component + an id branch in `columns/[column]/page.tsx`.
**Change a game cover:** set the `query` (and `since` year for remakes) in `src/components/BacklogColumn.tsx` SAGAS, or the post's `nightcap.game`.
**Run dev:** `npm run dev` (used on port 3007 in this project). **Build:** `npm run build`.

## Environment Variables

- `TWITCH_CLIENT_ID` — Twitch app client id (IGDB auth)
- `TWITCH_CLIENT_SECRET` — Twitch app secret (IGDB auth); keep in `.env.local`, rotate before launch
